title: Absorbing-layer (CPML) reflection vs its target reflection (analytic)
description:
A plane Ricker pressure pulse (normal traction sheet, 1 MHz) in a y-periodic water strip (elastic_waves) runs into the absorbing layers of both x faces (80 cells = 1 mm each, inside the domain, backed by a rigid wall). The sweep runs the layer's target reflection pml_reflection over 0.3-0.01.
Analytic (continuum CPML, order 2, kappa 1, alpha 0): the damping d0 = 3 c ln(1/R) / (2 L) attenuates the wave travelling in and back out by exp(-2 integral d / c dx) = R at every frequency, and the rigid backing reflects pressure with +1, so each echo is +R times the pulse that entered that layer, timed as a reflection at the domain edge. The +x traction compresses the +x side and rarefies the -x side: pressure +T/2 toward x_hi, -T/2 toward x_lo, so at the probe the x_hi echo is +R p_half and the x_lo echo -R p_half. Both echoes pass the probe (x = 10 mm; sheet at 5 mm): the x_lo echo after the path x_s + x_inc, the x_hi echo after 2 Lx - x_s - x_inc.
Time-stepped layer (R_disc): the CPML recursion psi = b psi + a dv/dx (b = exp(-d dt), a = b - 1, current derivative) stretches by 1/s_disc = (1/s) exp(-d dt / 2) to first order, an extra real stretch (still matched) and the damping d (1 + d dt / 2). The round trip adds exp(-dt integral d^2 / c dx) = exp(-0.45 (c dt / L) ln(1/R)^2), so the layer reflects less than its target: 0.5 % at R = 0.3, 7.3 % at R = 0.01 here (dt from courant_f, set explicitly).
Sweep tab: R_lo_matched and R_hi_matched (matched filters: the probe trace projected on the Ricker wavelet at each predicted arrival, over its energy, divided by the pressure of the wave that entered that layer: -p_half for x_lo, +p_half for x_hi) against the dashed R_disc.
Probes tab (last sweep value, R = 0.01): the incident pulse and the two echoes (x_lo inverted) with the dashed analytic trace.
Derived values tab: inc_matched (should be 1), R_lo_matched, R_hi_matched. Measured against R_disc: 0.08 % (R = 0.3) to 0.66 % (R = 0.01), the rest of the discrete layer (grading over 80 cells, higher orders in d dt); against the bare target R they were 0.6 % to 7.9 %. Tolerance 2 %.

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: Ricker peak frequency

parameters.name: t_d
parameters.description: time of the Ricker maximum at the sheet

parameters.name: T_sheet
parameters.description: peak normal traction of the sheet in Pa

parameters.name: p_half
parameters.description: pressure amplitude of each plane wave the sheet launches

parameters.name: rho_w
parameters.description: density of water in kg/m^3

parameters.name: c_w
parameters.description: sound speed of water in m/s

parameters.name: R_pml
parameters.description: target reflection of the absorbing layers (swept)

parameters.name: n_pml
parameters.description: absorbing layer cells per face (1 mm, 0.68 wavelengths at f0)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (47 cells per wavelength at 2.5 f0)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length (1600 cells)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height (periodic y)

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: y of the probe (a cell centre)

parameters.name: x_s
parameters.description: sheet position (cell centre, 5.006 mm)

parameters.name: x_inc
parameters.description: probe position (cell centre, 10.006 mm)

parameters.name: t_inc
parameters.description: incident pulse centre time at the probe

parameters.name: t_lo
parameters.description: x_lo echo centre time at the probe

parameters.name: t_hi
parameters.description: x_hi echo centre time at the probe

parameters.name: E_ric
parameters.description: Ricker energy: integral of w^2 dt in s

parameters.name: courant_f
parameters.description: elastic_waves time step factor (the default)

parameters.name: dt_step
parameters.description: time step of the run (square fluid cells: courant dx / (c sqrt 2))

parameters.name: L_pml
parameters.description: absorbing layer thickness

parameters.name: R_disc
parameters.description: reflection of the time-stepped layer: the CPML recursion damps at d (1 + d dt / 2), order 2 grading

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration (the x_hi echo has passed the probe)
